summary: Iteration 33 · Frontend refactor testing (sidebar collapse + Tournament sub-tab strip + new /tournament-calendar page). All 7 requested test scenarios executed via Playwright. 6/7 scenarios pass cleanly. One minor UX regression found — TournamentSubTabs strip does not render on the Locked/Not-yet-accepted variant of the Selection Console screen.

ui_bugs.issue: When a tournament's host-acceptance is still Pending, SelectionConsole short-circuits to the '🔒 Locked' fallback screen (lines 283-290) BEFORE rendering <TournamentSubTabs>. As a result the sticky sub-tab strip is missing on this screen even though the spec requires it to remain visible on every /tournaments/:id/* route. Reproduced by clicking the Squad sub-tab from /tournaments/f74daff6-8055-43bb-a684-c2ae3734c641 (Div-Sec persona, host acceptance Pending) → Locked screen renders, [data-testid='tournament-subtabs'] is absent.

issues: Recurring React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — the Emergent visual-editor is injecting <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option> tags in TournamentCreateModal (line 322) and SelectionConsole (line 514). Not caused by app code but pollutes console and can cause hydration mismatches in production.

action_items: Fix: Render <TournamentSubTabs tournamentId={id} active='squad' /> INSIDE the acceptanceOK-locked block in SelectionConsole.jsx (~line 283-290) so users retain sub-tab navigation from the Locked screen — currently they only get a 'Back to Calendar' button.
critical_code_review_comments: SelectionConsole.jsx line 283-290: Locked fallback returns without TournamentSubTabs — inconsistent with TournamentDetail.jsx and TournamentFinanceDetail.jsx which always render the sub-tab strip.

TournamentSubTabs.jsx line 32-35: On every subtab-mount the component fetches /reimbursement-claims?tournament_id=... — this happens once per tournament view but is fired on Overview/Squad/Finance mounts. Consider caching per tournament id in a context/store to avoid duplicate calls (minor perf).

ONE ISSUE: locked SelectionConsole (Pending acceptance) does not render TournamentSubTabs — see action_items.
rca of the issue: SelectionConsole.jsx returns an early JSX branch (lines 283-290) when acceptanceOK is false. This early-return happens BEFORE the main render tree that hosts <TournamentSubTabs> (line 298). Fix = insert the sub-tabs component inside the locked branch (or restructure so the strip is a common wrapper). Mitigation: user can still navigate via browser back or main sidebar; no data-loss.
